mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team (sports_meeting_id, group_type_id, name, leader, coach, total_score) VALUES (#{sportsMeetingId}, #{groupTypeId}, #{name}, #{leader}, #{coach}, #{totalScore})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.sports_meeting_id, t.name, t.leader, t.coach, t.total_score, sm.name AS sports_meeting_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participant p2 WHERE p2.team_id = t.id) AS member_count FROM team t JOIN sports_meeting sm ON t.sports_meeting_id = sm.id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM participant p WHERE p.team_id = t.id AND p.user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY t.sports_meeting_id DESC, t.id ASC
